description: Trigger a Fivetran connector sync via REST API.

force.label: Force
force.description: Sync even if no changes detected

wait_for_completion.label: Wait For Completion
wait_for_completion.description: Poll the connector's GET endpoint until the sync finishes. Fivetran's API has no discrete sync/job id -- completion is detected by comparing `succeeded_at`/`failed_at` timestamps (and `status.sync_state`) against the values recorded just before triggering, per Fivetran's own documented poll-for-completion pattern.

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: If set, this component emits a real materializable `@dg.asset` (with `deps`) instead of a plain op-job. `job_name`/`schedule` are ignored when this is set.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Asset group name. Only used when `asset_name` is set.
